propositions: Enable four approved Mypy strictness flags globally (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) while explicitly deferring disallow_any_generics and disallow_untyped_defs.

Remove redundant type casts and unused type-ignore suppressions across 22 files in the rebar reconciler and LLM workflow subsystems, measured against a pinned Mypy 2.3.0 environment with all project extras provisioned.
Establish a ratchet test in test_mypy_ratchet.py that enforces the four approved strictness flags are enabled and the two deferred flags remain disabled.
Verify that mypy src/rebar --warn-redundant-casts and mypy src/rebar --warn-unused-ignores both exit 0 after remediation of all diagnostics surfaced in the canonical environment.
Confirm behavior-adjacent tests and the full non-integration/non-external test suite pass after strictness flag enablement and diagnostic remediation.
